Definition: Rosh, the name of an Israelite and of a foreign nation
BiblicalUsage: The name is Rosh, the name of an Israelite and of a foreign nation. You find the name in Genesis 46:21: "…Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Rosh counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
